text: Real experiences from people who are learning and growing with us.

items.name: Andreia Barros
items.quote: I love the classes! The teacher is very attentive, patient and explains everything in a simple and easy-to-understand way. I have been improving a lot in English and I feel more and more comfortable speaking. Highly recommend!

items.name: Mauricio Moura
items.quote: I want to share my evaluation of the course. The teacher has vast knowledge of the English language and the ability to transfer that knowledge to students in a relaxed way. What I like most about my English class is the way she presents it, even when I don't know something. That helped me a lot to unlock my conversation. That's why I recommend Best Fluency.

items.name: Pedro António
items.quote: Great! I learn a lot with teacher Taty.

items.name: Romerson Neves
items.quote: I have been in Portugal for 7 months and I realized the importance of learning English for my life. I started with in-person classes, but the person who was teaching me had to leave the country and couldn't continue. Then I tried online classes with another teacher, but I didn't adapt. That's when I met teacher Tatiana. We had a trial class and I really liked it. Since then, I have continued the classes and I feel that I am improving every day. Teacher Tatiana has a lot of patience, explains clearly and conducts the classes excellently. I recommend her to everyone who wants to learn English with quality.

items.name: Sandro Vite
items.quote: Amazing, teaching that is very well applied and in a simple, objective way.

items.name: Wanda Ramos
items.quote: I want to share my evaluation of the course. Everything was very clear, with easy-to-understand content. Teacher Taty was great, very caring, made me feel very comfortable, motivated me which made me ask my questions without any embarrassment or fear of being wrong. I intend to go back to training to do another level as soon as possible. Thank you so much for the attention, dedication and care, Taty Viana.

founder.h2: Meet the founder of Best Fluency
text: I'm an engineer, a professional with international experience in technology and project management, and the founder of Best Fluency. Throughout my career, I had the opportunity to work in different companies, projects and international contexts — experiences that shaped the way I think, work and solve problems. It was all of this journey that I brought with me when I decided to venture into education.

I didn't stop being an engineer. I brought engineering with me. The experience I built over the years was applied in the creation of Best Fluency, from structuring the business to developing my own language teaching method. My own experience as a student also taught me that knowing a language doesn't necessarily mean having the confidence to speak — and it was from this reality that our approach was born: more practical, personalized and focused on communication.
Today, I see Best Fluency as the union of everything I built throughout my journey: experience, knowledge, innovation and the desire to transform the way people learn new languages.

faq.h2: Frequently asked questions about Best Fluency lessons
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers about in-person English lessons in Amadora and online.

items.question: Where do in-person lessons take place?
items.answer: In-person lessons take place at Espaço CASA, Avenida Chaby Pinheiro, 5, Venda Nova — Amadora.

items.question: Are there also online lessons?
items.answer: Yes. Best Fluency offers online lessons for students looking for more flexibility or who cannot travel to the in-person space.

items.question: Are there one-on-one and group lessons?
items.answer: Yes. There are one-on-one lessons and small groups, organized according to the students' level and availability.

items.question: How many students are in each group?
items.answer: Groups are small, allowing more participation and support during lessons.

items.question: Who are the lessons for?
items.answer: There are lessons for children, teens and adults, with content defined according to each student's age, level and goals.

items.question: Do I need to know English to start?
items.answer: No. Lessons are suitable for both beginners and students who already have some English knowledge and want to keep progressing.

items.question: How is my level identified?
items.answer: Before the lessons start, we have a brief conversation to understand the student's current knowledge, main difficulties and goals.

items.question: Are the lessons personalized?
items.answer: Yes. The content, activities and pace of the lessons are adjusted to each student's level, needs and progress.

items.question: How long does each lesson last?
items.answer: Each lesson lasts 50 minutes, focused on practice, participation and continuous progress.

items.question: How does the trial lesson work?
items.answer: The trial lesson lets you get to know Best Fluency's approach, ask questions and see how the teaching can be adapted to the student's goals.

items.question: How can I book a lesson?
items.answer: Just click a WhatsApp button and tell us the type of lesson you want and your availability.

items.question: How can I get more information?
items.answer: You can contact us via WhatsApp to clarify any questions you may have.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Learn how Best Fluency handles your personal data on this website. Information about cookies, analytics, service providers and your rights.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy describes how data is handled on the Best Fluency Language School website (hereinafter "Best Fluency" or "the website").
By accessing the website, you agree to the practices described in this policy. If you do not agree, you should refrain from using the website.

sections.title: 2. Data controller
paragraphs: Best Fluency Language School is a brand operated by VianaHub, Lda., responsible for processing personal data in the context of this website.
For questions regarding personal data processing, you can contact us at: vianahub.pt@gmail.com.

sections.title: 3. Data that may be processed
paragraphs: This website is designed to collect the minimum amount of personal data possible. Our focus is on providing information and facilitating the user's voluntary contact.
The following types of data may be processed:
items: Technical access information: IP address, browser type, operating system, pages visited, time spent and visit origin, collected in aggregate by analytics services.

UTM campaign parameters: when you access the site through a campaign link (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content), these parameters are captured in the session for visit origin attribution.
Consent preference: your choice to accept or reject analytics cookies is stored in localStorage to remember your preference.

Voluntarily initiated contact: when the user decides to contact Best Fluency through WhatsApp, phone or other channels, the data transmitted in that interaction is processed by the respective third-party service.

sections.title: 4. Google Analytics 4
paragraphs: This website uses Google Analytics 4 for aggregate usage measurement. GA4 is only loaded after the user's explicit consent.
When the user accepts, GA4 is configured with the following consent states:

subsections.title: What this means
paragraphs: Google Analytics may create first-party cookies (_ga, _ga_*) to measure site usage in aggregate.
No advertising cookies or features (Google Ads) are enabled.
The user may revoke consent at any time through "Manage cookies" in the website footer.

sections.title: 5. Cloudflare Web Analytics
paragraphs: This website uses Cloudflare Web Analytics as its base measurement. This implementation is designed to work without cookies and without requiring consent.
Cloudflare Web Analytics measures visits, page views, traffic sources, devices, countries and Core Web Vitals in aggregate.
The Cloudflare beacon is loaded independently of the user's consent decision, as it does not use cookies or collect personally identifiable data.

sections.title: 6. Consent preference
paragraphs: The user's consent preference is stored in the browser's localStorage with the key bestfluency:consent:v1.
This storage only records the user's choice: "accepted" (accepted analytics) or "rejected" (rejected analytics).
The preference is maintained until changed or deleted by the user.
No cookies are created for this purpose — the choice is stored exclusively in localStorage.

sections.title: 7. Campaign parameters
paragraphs: When the user accesses the website through a link with UTM parameters (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content), these are captured on the first visit of the session.
UTM parameters are stored in the browser's sessionStorage (key best-fluency:utm:session) and used for visit origin attribution during the session.
UTMs are maintained throughout the browsing session and allow traffic origin attribution even when the user navigates between different languages of the website.

sections.title: 8. Contact via WhatsApp
paragraphs: When the user decides to contact Best Fluency through WhatsApp, they are redirected to a third-party service (WhatsApp, owned by Meta Platforms, Inc.).

Best Fluency does not control or is responsible for the data processing performed by WhatsApp/Meta. The user should consult WhatsApp's privacy policy for information about their data processing on that platform.

sections.title: 9. Service providers
paragraphs: This website uses the following technology service providers that may have access to usage data:
items: Google Analytics (Google LLC) — website usage measurement, after consent
Cloudflare (Cloudflare, Inc.) — website analytics and protection, without cookies
WhatsApp (Meta Platforms, Inc.) — voluntary user contact channel

sections.title: 10. International transfers
paragraphs: Some of the service providers mentioned (Google, Cloudflare) are based in the United States of America and other countries outside the European Economic Area.
Data processing by these providers may occur outside the EEA, in accordance with the legal mechanisms and data protection policies of each provider.
There are no data transfers for advertising or direct marketing purposes.

sections.title: 11. Data retention
paragraphs: The consent preference is retained in the user's browser until changed or deleted.
Browsing data collected by analytics services is retained in accordance with the settings and retention policies of each provider.
The website does not maintain personal databases beyond what is strictly necessary for its operation and measurement.

sections.title: 12. Data subject rights
paragraphs: Under applicable data protection legislation, you have the right to:
items: Restrict the processing of your data
Withdraw consent at any time without compromising the legality of processing carried out up to the date of withdrawal

subsections.title: How to exercise these rights
paragraphs: To exercise any of your rights, you may contact us at vianahub.pt@gmail.com or through the channels available on the website, namely via WhatsApp.
To withdraw analytics consent, use the "Manage cookies" feature available in the website footer.

sections.title: 13. Children and minors
paragraphs: The Best Fluency website provides information about English classes for children. However, the website does not directly collect personal data from children.
When applicable, contacts, enrollments and decisions regarding minors must be made by the legal guardian.

sections.title: 14. Security
paragraphs: Best Fluency adopts appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration or disclosure.
However, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is fully secure, so absolute security cannot be guaranteed.

sections.title: 15. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy may be updated without prior notice. We recommend periodic review of this page.
The date of the last update is indicated at the top of this document.

sections.title: 16. Contact
paragraphs: For questions related to this Privacy Policy or the processing of your personal data, you may contact us at vianahub.pt@gmail.com or through the channels available on the website, namely via WhatsApp.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.metaDescription: Learn about the storage technologies used by Best Fluency on this website, including cookies, localStorage and sessionStorage.

sections.title: 1. What are cookies
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored in the user's browser when they access a website. They allow the website to remember the user's actions and preferences over time.
In addition to cookies, there are other storage technologies used by websites, such as localStorage and sessionStorage, which work similarly but with different characteristics.

sections.title: 2. Technologies used by Best Fluency
paragraphs: The Best Fluency website uses the following storage technologies:
items: Local storage (localStorage) — to store the consent preference
Session storage (sessionStorage) — to store campaign parameters during the session

sections.title: 3. Required storage
paragraphs: The website uses local storage to store your cookie consent preference.
items: Purpose: stores the user's consent choice ("accepted" or "rejected")
Category: necessary — allows remembering the user's privacy preference
Does not depend on analytics acceptance

sections.title: 4. Session data and UTM parameters
paragraphs: When the user accesses the website through a campaign link, UTM parameters are captured and stored in sessionStorage.
items: Purpose: visit origin attribution during the session (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content)
Duration: ends when the browser is closed or the session is terminated

sections.title: 5. Cloudflare Web Analytics
paragraphs: Cloudflare Web Analytics is a measurement tool that works without cookies.
The Cloudflare beacon is loaded independently of cookie consent, as it does not use cookies or store data in the user's browser.
It measures visits, page views, traffic sources, devices, countries and Core Web Vitals in aggregate.

sections.title: 6. Google Analytics 4
paragraphs: Google Analytics 4 is only loaded after the user's explicit consent through the cookie banner.
When the user accepts analytics, Google Analytics may create first-party cookies to measure website usage in aggregate.
items: _ga_* — first-party cookies for sessions and analytics
Purpose: aggregate measurement of usage and events

subsections.title: Cookie duration
paragraphs: The duration of Google Analytics cookies may depend on the service configuration and the user's browser settings.

sections.title: 7. Advertising
paragraphs: Currently, the website does not grant consent for advertising cookie storage or usage.
Advertising consent states are permanently configured as denied:
No Google Ads or other advertising platform cookies are enabled by this implementation.

sections.title: 8. Managing cookies
paragraphs: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time through the "Manage cookies" link available in the website footer.
When accessing this feature, you can:

subsections.title: Revocation
paragraphs: If you had previously accepted and choose to reject, the following process is executed:
The consent preference is updated to "rejected" in localStorage.
Google Analytics receives the consent update to denied.
First-party GA cookies (_ga, _ga_*) are deleted.
The page is reloaded to ensure GA stops working.

sections.title: 9. Browser settings
paragraphs: You can also delete cookies and storage data through your browser settings.
Deleting cookies or storage data through the browser does not affect the consent preference stored on the website — the cookie banner may reappear on your next visit.
